title: The support of a finite type quasi-coherent module is closed, locally the zero locus of the annihilator
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent], with support $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)=\{x\in X:\mathcal F_x\neq0\}$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base](2), $\mathcal F_x$ the stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be an affine open, $A=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $M=\mathcal F(U)$ (a finitely generated $A$-module), and identify $U$ with $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the point $x\in U$ corresponding to the prime $\mathfrak p_x\subseteq A$. Then $\mathcal F_x\cong M_{\mathfrak p_x}$, and $x\in\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ if and only if $\operatorname{Ann}_A(M)=\{a\in A: aM=0\}\subseteq\mathfrak p_x$; that is, $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\cap U=V(\operatorname{Ann}_A(M))$. Consequently $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ is a closed subset of $X$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 056J (morphisms-lemma-support-finite-type) part (1), via Lemma 056I (morphisms-lemma-support-affine-open), Properties Lemma 01PB (properties-lemma-finite-type-module) and Algebra Lemma 00L2 (algebra-lemma-support-closed, literature/stacks-project/algebra.tex) as in its proof

proof.text: For a quasi-coherent module F and affine open U, give the stalk its Gamma(X,U)-module structure through the ring germ. The ring stalk is localization at the prime of x, so every denominator has a unit germ and acts invertibly on the module stalk. Basic opens of U form a neighbourhood basis.

Represent a stalk element by a section over V. Choose D(g) containing x inside V. The affine basic-open localization lemma extends the restricted section after multiplication by g^n; taking germs gives the surjectivity axiom of IsLocalizedModule. For equal germs of sections over U, germ_eq gives equality on a neighbourhood V; shrink to D(g), apply the vanishing half of basic-open localization to their difference, and get g^n times the difference zero. The canonical IsLocalizedModule.iso therefore gives the additive equivalence; linearity and mk_cancel give the required germ identity.

Restriction preserves finite type: restrict the local generating cover along Over.forget U and map its finite generating families through the local left adjoints, which preserve colimits and the unit. This is the proved private isFiniteType_over helper. Apply the finite-generation clause of quasicoherent_finite_type_affine. Transfer nontriviality through the stalk equivalence and apply Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite (Algebra 00L2).

For each affine U, use fromSpec_primeIdealOf to send a point of the support to its prime in V(Ann). Conversely a prime in V(Ann) maps into U by range_fromSpec; injectivity of the open immersion identifies its inverse prime, and the support criterion gives membership. This proves the stated image equality.

For a point outside the support, choose an affine neighbourhood U. The image under fromSpec of the complement of V(Ann Gamma(F,U)) is open, contains the point, and lies in the support complement by the pointwise support criterion. Thus the support complement is open and the support is closed.
